title: Title Desk Table: Start Date of the Trade-In Chargeback Clock
content:
The title-delay chargeback clock on a **Trade-In Agreements** agreement is counted in calendar days to the day the chargeback is booked. The date it runs from depends on when the lien on the traded vehicle was actually paid off, read from the agreement's history: the date of its lien payoff entry and the date of its latest customer payment entry.

## Rule

| Agreement's history | Clock runs from |
|---|---|
| Lien payoff entry dated more than 3 days after the pickup date | That payoff date |
| Lien payoff entry dated no more than 3 days after the pickup date, and the latest customer payment entry dated after the pickup date | That customer payment date |
| Every other case (including no lien payoff entry) | The pickup date |

## Worked cases (hypothetical dates; pickup on the 1st, chargeback booked on the 70th day after it)

| Lien payoff entry | Latest customer payment entry | Clock runs from | Clock length on the booking day |
|---|---|---|---|
| Day 6 after pickup | Day 2 after pickup | Day 6 | 64 days |
| Day 3 after pickup | Day 2 after pickup | Day 2 | 68 days |
| Day 3 after pickup | None | Pickup date | 70 days |
| Day 2 after pickup | On the pickup date | Pickup date | 70 days |
| None | Day 5 after pickup | Pickup date | 70 days |

## Boundary

A payoff entry dated exactly 3 days after pickup is not more than 3 days after it.
